changesAfterInitialPublication: Bounded scene raster cache for translations; all facts and edges retained; one backing bitmap capped at 16M pixels/64MB, with direct rendering fallback.
Benchmark reference timing excludes trace/video recording, preserves raw intervals/GPU/browser details and continues stress fixtures after a failed target.
Tooltip test waits for intentional inspector opening autofocus before asserting a subsequent search focus and Escape dismissal. Runtime focus behavior unchanged.
limits: 10k remains stress-only: cached pan improved but initial rendering still has long tasks on the hosted software renderer.
A backing-bitmap cap is not a bound on total browser/GPU/process memory. Manual GPU/reference matrix and staging remain required.
Human browser-zoom/accessibility/task review, live account terms/model evaluation and hosted release acceptance remain open; intelligence stays disabled.
